content:
**Ninja** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Ninja multiplicatively increases the damage dealt by sneak attacks while using unarmed, one-handed and two-handed melee weapons.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Bows, throwing, and melee weapons do +100% sneak attack damage. | 000E3704 | 
| ★ | 1 | Bows, throwing, and melee weapons do +50% sneak attack damage. | 0004D8A6 | 

Ninja stacks with Covert Operative while using unarmed melee weapons. Using Covert Operative 3 and Ninja 3 will yield a x3.4 sneak attack multiplier on unarmed weapons. [verification overdue]
